question.knowledge_point: Computing a Probability Involving Mutually Exclusive Events
question.problem: Suppose that $A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive events. Given that $P(B)=\frac{18}{25}$ and $P(A\cup B)=\frac{4}{5},$ find $P(A).$
question.worked_solution:
If $A$ and $B$ are mutually exclusive events, then $P(A\cap B)=0.$ 

Therefore, by the addition law, we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}P(A\cup B) & =P(A)+P(B) \\ P(A) & =P(A\cup B)-P(B) \\  & =\frac{4}{5}-\frac{18}{25} \\  & =\frac{20-18}{25} \\  & =\frac{2}{25}\,.\end{aligned}
$$
